advance_rule: The first candidate must fit both GPUs, pass 64/64 complete token identity, zero cached tokens, zero cross-base collisions, cache liveness, clean shutdown, and kernel-health gates, and exceed the higher qualified down+gate observation of 175.798577 tok/s. No failed-arm or single-run speed is promoted; no rate transfers to another concurrency, context, quant, card count, MTP depth, or one-user route. The existing qualified down+gate result remains public unless the full promotion rule passes.
